boards.title: Company job boards
boards.description: List of { "ats": "greenhouse"|"lever", "slug": "company-board-slug" }. The slug is the company identifier in the board's own URL, e.g. https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe -> slug "stripe"; https://jobs.lever.co/palantir -> slug "palantir".

keywordFilter.title: Title keyword filter
keywordFilter.description: Only keep jobs whose title contains one of these (case-insensitive). Leave empty to keep all jobs.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Fetch the full job description text (larger records). Off by default.
